extName.description: Store listing name. Keep the brand lowercase: zvena.

extDescription.message: Save any web page to zvena Docs: the full article, a bookmark, or just the part you selected.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary, at most 132 characters.

cmdOpen.description: Keyboard shortcut description: opens the popup.

cmdSavePage.message: Save this page to the last destination
cmdSavePage.description: Keyboard shortcut description: saves without the popup.

connectLead.message: Connect the clipper to your zvena account. It can only add pages; it never reads your documents.

connectWaiting.message: Finish connecting in the zvena tab that just opened.

destPrivate.description: The person's Private section in zvena Docs (as in Notion).

destPrivateHint.message: A new page in your Private section

modeArticle.description: Save the readable content of the whole page.

modeSelection.description: Save only the selected part of the page.

serverHint.message: The address of your zvena server, for example https://zvena.example.com.

serverInvalid.message: Enter the address of a zvena server, such as https://zvena.example.com.

errBadRequest.message: zvena couldn't save this page. Try another “Save as” option.

errUnauthorized.message: The connection to zvena has ended. Connect again.

errForbidden.message: You can't add pages there. Pick another destination.

errNotFound.message: That page or database no longer exists. Pick another destination.

errTooLarge.message: This page is too large to save. Try Bookmark or Selection.

errRateLimited.message: Too many clips at once. Try again in a minute.

errServer.message: zvena is unavailable right now. Try again later.

errNetwork.message: Can't reach zvena. Check your connection.

errNoPage.message: This page can't be clipped (browser pages and extension stores are protected). Try another tab.

errNoSelection.message: Select some text on the page first.

errPermission.message: Access to the zvena server wasn't allowed.
